description: Search current job listings. For requests like "find remote Python jobs", "marketing jobs in New York", "junior data analyst jobs posted this week", "senior software engineer jobs in London", "nurse jobs in Manchester". Job words go in what and the place in where. Everyday phrasing in what also works: level words (junior, senior), "remote", "in <city>" and "this week" are picked out. The say line credits listings from Remotive, Himalayas, Jobicy and Remote OK to their source.

benefits.description: Benefits the advert must mention, comma separated, for example "pension, private healthcare".

company.description: Only jobs at this company, for example "Tesco".

country.description: US or UK, when the place exists in both (Birmingham, Manchester, Cambridge) and the user's country is known. Optional.

education.description: Education: degree for jobs asking for a degree, or no degree for jobs that don't.

employer.description: Employer: direct for jobs posted by the employer itself, or agency for recruitment agencies.

exclude.description: Words the advert must not contain, comma separated, for example "sales, commission".

include.description: Words the advert must contain, comma separated, for example "python, aws".

job_type.description: Job type: full time, part time, contract, temporary or internship.

level.description: Level: entry (junior, graduate, intern), mid or senior. With entry, jobs asking for more than 2 years of experience are left out and the answer adds apprenticeship and graduate routes.

page.description: Which page of results, 1 to 20. Default 1. Use 2 for "show me more".

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days, 1 to 90. Default 30. 7 means this week.

radius_miles.description: How far from the place, in miles, 1 to 100 (boards that support distance).

salary_max.description: Highest yearly pay, in the local currency.

salary_min.description: Lowest yearly pay, in the local currency, for example 40000 or 40k. Jobs that list no pay are left out when set.

shift.description: Shift: day, evening, night, weekend or flexible.

sort.description: Sort: relevance (default), date (newest first) or pay (highest first).

visa_sponsorship.description: Set to yes for jobs whose advert says visa sponsorship is offered.

what.description: Job title, skill or field, for example "python developer" or "marketing". Required unless where is given.

where.description: A city (New York, Austin, TX, London, Birmingham, UK), a US state (Texas), a UK county or region (Kent, Yorkshire), a UK postcode, a city or country abroad (Bangalore, Dublin, Dubai, Sydney, India), a country (USA, UK, Germany), "remote", or remote in a country ("remote US").

work_type.description: Work type: remote, hybrid or on-site.

name: search_jobs
title: Search current job listings
